description: Free. The same label as lumi_verdict from Lumi's record (cached, no live contact with the seller), signed by Lumi: checks_passed, check_first, checks_failed or no_data, with reason codes and an evidence link. Of the URL, only the origin and path are sent; payTo and amount are sent if you pass them. Use lumi_verdict when you want the live check at call time.

amount.description: Optional: the quoted price in USD, e.g. 0.01

payTo.description: Optional: the payTo address in its 402 quote

url.description: The x402 resource URL (or the seller's domain) you are about to pay

name: lumi_check_free
title: Lumi: free signed seller check (cached)
